title: Jerax
overview: The series is set in the small town of Malavalli and follows Prakasha (Nagabhushana NS), a struggling Xerox shop owner. His life takes a supernatural turn when he discovers a mysterious metal that, when merged with his photocopier, allows the machine to create human clones. These duplicates possess the memories and traits of the originals, leading to a mix of personal experiments, political satire, and town-wide chaos.
